pyq.q: Which of the following is frequently used to ensure that data is correctly entered into a computer?
pyq.e: Input controls (validation and verification checks) ensure data is entered correctly; keyboards and digitisers only capture data and speakers are output devices. Note: The official key gives (a); the correct answer is (c).

pyq.q:
Which of the following statement is/are correct?
I. Metropolitan Area Network (MAN) is a collection of Local Area Networks (LANs) connected together over a city.
II. Metropolitan Area Network (MAN) supports both data and voice transmission.
pyq.e: A MAN interconnects LANs over a city and carries both data and voice (e.g. IEEE 802.6 DQDB), so both statements are true. Note: The old key (a) was wrong; the correct answer is (c).

pyq.q: Which of the following is correct for Digital Circuits?
o: They use analog signals for communication
They process information using continuous voltage levels
They are not suitable for high speed operations
More than one of the above
pyq.e: Digital circuits use discrete 0/1 levels and are used in very fast devices, so (a), (b), (c) and hence (d) are false. Note: The old key (c) was wrong; the correct answer is (e).

pyq.q: Semaphore are used to solve the problem of:
pyq.e: Semaphores enforce mutual exclusion on shared resources and thereby eliminate race conditions; multi-tasking is an OS feature. Note: The old key (c) was wrong; the correct answer is (d).

pyq.q: A measure of amount of memory required to execute an algorithm is known as:
pyq.e: Space complexity is the total memory an algorithm needs as a function of input size; time complexity/efficiency measure running time. Note: The old key (d) was wrong; the correct answer is (a).

pyq.q:
Consider the given memory representation of the singly linked list where start points to the address of first node of the linked list, which is memory location 0. If a new node whose data value is X is inserted after the node whose data value is E in any free location available in the memory, then what will the memory representation be after inserting the new node?
Memory location | Item value | Pointer to next element
0 | A | 4
1 | E | 2
2 | B | NULL
3 | (free) | —
4 | C | 1
o: After inserting X: Loc0=A→3, Loc1=E→2, Loc2=B→NULL, Loc3=X→4, Loc4=C→1
After inserting X: Loc0=A→4, Loc1=E→2, Loc2=B→NULL, Loc3=X→1, Loc4=C→3
After inserting X: Loc0=A→4, Loc1=E→2, Loc2=B→3, Loc3=X→NULL, Loc4=C→1
After inserting X: Loc0=A→4, Loc1=E→3, Loc2=B→NULL, Loc3=X→2, Loc4=C→1
pyq.e: The list is A→C→E→B; X goes in free location 3, so X→2 (B) and E→3, giving A→C→E→X→B. Note: The old key (a) was wrong; the correct answer is (d).

Which of the following declaration/statement will invoke the default constructor of the class - STOCK ?
pyq.e: The default constructor takes no arguments and runs for a declaration like STOCK S2;. S1(S2) calls the copy constructor and S1(20) the parameterised one. Note: The official key gives (c); the correct answer is (b).

pyq.q: Identify the descending order of strict access protection.
pyq.e: From strictest to least strict the Java access levels are private, package (default), protected, public. Note: The official key gives (b); the correct answer is (d).

pyq.q: Which of the following is not a valid variable name in most programming languages?
o: More than one of the above
pyq.e: 'my Variable' has a space and '123Variable' starts with a digit, so both (a) and (b) are invalid; '_myVariable' is valid. Note: The official key gives (b); the correct answer is (d).

pyq.q: Which of the following constructors is provided by the C++ compiler if not defined in a class?
o: More than one of the above
pyq.e: The compiler implicitly supplies both a default constructor and a copy constructor, but never a parameterized one. Note: The official key gives (b); the correct answer is (d).

pyq.q: The functions 'cin' and 'cout' resolve the necessary conversions at :
pyq.e: cin/cout use overloaded >> and << operators chosen by the compiler from operand types, so conversions are resolved at compile time. Note: The old key (b) was wrong; the correct answer is (a).

pyq.q: Additional information sent when an exception is thrown may be placed in _____.
o: The function that caused the error
An object of the exception class
pyq.e: The thrown object (of an exception class) carries the extra error information to the handler; the catch block only receives it. Note: The official key gives (c); the correct answer is (d).

pyq.q:
Which of the given options best describes the truthfulness of the following statements?
i) A tuple is a sequence of immutable Python objects, in the given tuple course = "l", "m", "n", "o", has four elements.
ii) To explicitly remove an entire tuple, use the drop statement.
pyq.e: Statement i is true; statement ii is false because a tuple is removed with del, and Python has no drop statement. Note: The old key (c) was wrong for the old wording; the correct answer is (c) i-True, ii-False.

pyq.q: Which sorting algorithm performs the worst when the input array is nearly sorted?
pyq.e: Max (selection-type) sort always makes n(n-1)/2 comparisons, so it gains nothing from nearly-sorted input, whereas insertion sort is adaptive. Note: The official key gives (c); the correct answer is (a).

pyq.q: Which of the following statements is NOT true with respect to database normalization?
o: A 4NF table is more immune against logical inconsistencies than a 3NF table.
A 3NF table will have fewer anomalies than a 2NF table.
A 3NF table is more vulnerable than a 2NF table.
A database is said to be in 3NF if all its tables are in 3NF
pyq.e: Higher normal forms have fewer anomalies, so saying a 3NF table is more vulnerable than a 2NF table is false. Note: The old key (a) was wrong; the correct answer is (c).

pyq.q: ________ is the address of the current tunnel endpoint for MN that can be chosen via DHCP.
pyq.e: In Mobile IP the care-of address (COA) is the mobile node's current tunnel endpoint and can be co-located and obtained via DHCP. Note: The official key gives (a); the correct answer is (b).
pyq.topic: Application Layer Protocols (HTTP, DNS, FTP, SMTP)

pyq.q: ________ is the standard that defines how web servers and application programs communicate.
pyq.e: CGI (Common Gateway Interface) defines communication between a web server and external programs; HTTP is browser-to-server, JDBC/ODBC are for databases. Note: The official key gives (d); the correct answer is (c).

pyq.q: Multimedia is widely used to add special_____ to movies
pyq.e: Multimedia (CGI, sound, animation) is used to create special effects in films. Note: The official key gives (a); the correct answer is (c).

pyq.q: Which method creates interpolants that are softer?
pyq.e: Polynomial and spline interpolants are smooth, whereas piecewise constant gives jumps and linear gives corners. Note: The official key gives (b); the correct answer is (a).

pyq.q: According to business economics, the growth of an existing product is used to estimate the demand for a new product using:
pyq.e: In the growth curve approach (Joel Dean), demand for a new product is estimated from the growth pattern of an existing product. Note: The official key gives (c); the correct answer is (a).
pyq.topic: Demand, Supply, Elasticity, Cost & Market Structure

pyq.q: What is effective desire?
pyq.e: Demand is effective desire: desire backed by ability and willingness to pay. Note: The official key gives (b); the correct answer is (a).
pyq.topic: Demand, Supply, Elasticity, Cost & Market Structure
